risks.risk: MFA gap on privileged or high-risk access path
risks.recommended_action: Validate MFA and Conditional Access enforcement with the identity owner.
Review administrative role assignments and move toward approved time-bound access where possible.
Confirm owner, scope permissions, and monitor service account activity.
Review account lifecycle evidence before disabling or removing access.

evidence_boundary: Simulated case data only. No production identity system changes were performed.
